title: 1:55–2:20 · A confirmed launch is scored on your spends
lede: Voiceover: “When the bank's page confirms a card, the engine scores it on your budget. If it would earn you at least ₹2,000 a year and 15% of its fee, it becomes a notice. Card Finder asks your reward type and fee limit the first time, then ranks the best 1 to 3 cards to add.”
